steps.what: Clarify the communication need, permissions and participants
Coordinate communication and reconcile conflicting explanations

tasks.design: Retain direct coordination through {TELEPHONY} and {EMAIL}. Permission, conflicting accounts and the urgency of a concern determine what can be shared and with whom; no automatic forwarding is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Messages often require context and permission checks.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated tool removes the mediation work in this boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Family wishes, patient wishes and clinical accounts can conflict.
tasks.human_edge: The representative builds trust and ensures each person understands the next action.
tasks.altitude: Coordination responsibility and time remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Interpersonal mediation and permission-sensitive coordination remain human work in this E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is case communication after the concern has been identified; the separate patient interview is not repeated here.
No machine action or structured routing contract is introduced.
Existing communication facilities suffice; no custom code is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow change is claimed.
unknowns: Participant mix and existing escalation pathways
research_questions: Is any repetitive clerical routing actually present outside the mediation itself?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Conversations and permission checks retain all their time; no invented forwarding baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview patients about problems with care

steps.what: Interview patients and clarify their account of care problems

tasks.design: Keep interviewing and clarification with the representative. Existing information in {DOCS} may inform questions, but the interview is not replaced by a form or recording.
tasks.previous_blocker: A patient's account may emerge gradually through trust.
tasks.enabler_now: No tool establishes equivalent understanding for this conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Distress, ambiguity and unequal power can inhibit disclosure.
tasks.human_edge: The representative listens, checks understanding and notices what has not been said.
tasks.altitude: No change to the interviewing role or time is claimed.

reach.learn: Local escalation and clinical responsibility boundaries

evidence.claim: Retaining the patient interview is an E1 assessment from model knowledge, with no measured savings claim.

assumptions: Boundary is listening and clarification; documentation or complaint administration needs separate evidence.
No machine action or new structured input is assumed.
No custom tool is proposed; existing records remain references.
Zero upkeep because this task is unchanged.
research_questions: Which barriers prevent patients from explaining their concerns fully?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. The interview remains human and no hypothetical note-writing time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain current knowledge of community resources

steps.what: Locate current community services information and provider updates
Verify service details and maintain practical resource knowledge

tasks.design: Configure saved searches and keyword filters in {DOCS} for the existing resource collection. The representative still reads source documents, contacts providers when needed and learns which services are relevant; search results are not eligibility decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Resource information is dispersed and can become stale.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed search can reduce repeated locating of known source material.
tasks.still_hard: Availability, suitability and referral conditions may need direct provider confirmation.
tasks.human_edge: The representative understands the practical meaning and limits of a service.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated searching, with the same responsibility for current resource knowledge.

reach.learn: Referral boundaries and source currency checks

evidence.claim: Saved search over resource documents is a proposed E1 configuration from model knowledge; the digest provides no measured case for maintaining resource knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is finding, verifying and learning resource information, not patient-specific referral or booking.

Providers produce their publications and notices in the existing baseline. No fresh structured eligibility, availability or service catalogue is assumed; missing details are obtained manually in unchanged s2.
The representative supplies search words in s1 and checks source dates in s2; both retain time. Search never creates a verified current-status flag.
Test native document indexing before code; allow four focal hours for saved-search repair and stale-source cleanup.
research_questions: Does native search reduce locating time without hiding changed referral conditions?

already_counted.description: Read, verify and learn current resource details

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R88 gross12 minus4 upkeep =8 net. High assumes substantial repeated locating; low assumes fragmented unindexed sources. Reading and provider checking remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain care policies, procedures and services

steps.what: Find the current policy or procedure relevant to the question
Explain policies and procedures and check patient understanding

tasks.design: Use native keyword search in {DOCS} to locate current approved policy passages. The representative reads them, applies their knowledge and explains the answer personally, referring clinical or ambiguous questions to the responsible professional.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the right approved passage can take repeated searching.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document search and filters can shorten retrieval without generating advice.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining exceptions and checking understanding require context and care.
tasks.human_edge: The representative adapts the explanation to the patient and recognises limits of their authority.
tasks.altitude: Less searching; personal explanation and responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Policy version checks and referral boundaries

evidence.claim: A policy answer desk with human conversations is an E1 design from model knowledge; the digest's complaint-law source is not a product or productivity case.

assumptions: Boundary is retrieval and explanation of policy; policy authoring and clinical advice are outside it.

The existing policy owner publishes approved documents with title, version and effective date as part of current work. Missing or conflicting versions trigger manual owner clarification in s1, whose time remains positive.
The representative supplies query words in s1; no free structured patient classification or automatic policy selection is assumed.
Test native search first; allow four focal hours for broken searches and source checks beyond routine retrieval.
research_questions: Can representatives find the current passage faster without increasing incorrect explanations?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R90 gross10 minus4 upkeep =6 net. High requires a repeated retrieval burden; low allows already-fast search. All conversation time remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Use current source material more readily while retaining patient interviews, mediation and personal explanations.
reach: Support nursing staff with community-resource sources
Help patient administration locate approved explanations
role.ambitious_version: A trusted representative who helps patients understand their options and connects people without automating sensitive conversations.
